name: magpie-chatgpt-web-auth
description: ChatGPT web app for magpie: sentinel handshake, local proof of work and turnstile, patch-stream projection. Experimental.

summary.en: Experimental: ChatGPT's web app with its sentinel handshake, local proof of work and turnstile. The upstream may refuse non-browser TLS fingerprints.
